description: Find words by combined meaning, sound, spelling, and named lexical relations. Supply at least one hard constraint; relations form a conjunction, including repeated entries. Context and topics only affect ordering and require single words. Spanish supports meaning, sound, and spelling; relations require English. Empty results succeed; byte budgets select whole rows and offsets re-run the query without stable rankings or totals.

include_definitions.description: Include upstream definitions; senses may make the response substantially larger.

include_ipa.description: Request IPA tags and imply pronunciation; raw ARPAbet and IPA tags may both be returned.

include_pronunciation.description: Request raw pronunciation tags; ARPAbet stress digits are 0 unstressed, 1 primary, 2 secondary. May be guessed or omitted.

left_context.description: Single word preceding a result as an ordering hint, not an adjacency filter; blank means unset.

limit.description: Positive safe-integer row limit, default 20; values above 1000 are clamped and disclosed. Whole rows may be cut by the response byte budget.

means_like.description: Related meaning, at most 500 characters; blank means unset.

offset.description: Best-effort row offset, 0–999; re-runs the query, so rankings may change. No snapshot or total count.

relations.description: At most 14 relation entries; repeats preserved; empty means unset.

items.description: One relation constraint, conjoined with every other constraint.

relation.description: Named relation; use datamuse_list_reference topic=relations for direction.

word.description: Nonblank target word or phrase, at most 200 characters; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

right_context.description: Single word following a result as an ordering hint, not an adjacency filter; blank means unset.

sounds_like.description: Sound similarity, at most 200 characters; pronunciation may be guessed; blank means unset.

spelled_like.description: Upstream spelling pattern, at most 200 characters: * any length, ? one character, //listen anagrams (including phrases), @ English vowel including y, # consonant, +letters restricts allowed letters (repeats/spaces possible), -letters excludes letters. Without syntax, similar spellings. Blank means unset.

topics.description: At most five nonblank single-word topic biases, without whitespace or commas.

items.description: Single topic word; blank entries are omitted.

vocabulary.description: English or Spanish; all relations require English.

name: datamuse_find_words

effectiveQuery.description: Normalized search inputs, relations, defaults, and metadata flags.

include_pronunciation.description: Whether pronunciation was requested, including when implied by IPA.

ipa.description: Resolved upstream IPA selector when enabled.

requestedLimit.description: Original positive safe-integer limit when clamped above 1000.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_rejected`: HTTP 400. `upstream_validation`: HTTP 422. `upstream_unauthorized`: HTTP 401. `upstream_forbidden`: HTTP 403. `upstream_not_found`: HTTP 404 on the fixed endpoint. `upstream_conflict`: HTTP 409. `upstream_rate_limited`: HTTP 429. `pacer_shed`: Shared queue full or wait budget exhausted. `invalid_upstream_response`: Invalid JSON or malformed response shape. `upstream_unexpected_status`: Unexpected redirect or other non-success status. `missing_constraint`: No nonblank hard constraint. `unsupported_vocabulary_relation`: Spanish vocabulary with relations. `invalid_context_hint`: A context hint or topic is not a single word. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitReached.description: Whether the returned count equals the requested cap; more matches may exist.

nextOffset.description: Best-effort next row index within the API ceiling, when a byte cut or reached fetch cap permits navigation; not a stable cursor.

returnedCount.description: Number of returned words, not a total-match estimate.

truncated.description: Whether complete rows were omitted locally by the byte budget; not upstream exhaustion.

words.description: Matching upstream rows in original order; empty is a successful result.

defHeadword.description: Optional upstream headword associated with definitions.

defs.description: Optional raw definitions; tabs and whitespace are preserved.

numSyllables.description: Optional upstream syllable count, which may be guessed.

score.description: Optional upstream ranking score; not confidence or frequency.

tags.description: Optional raw metadata tags, including unknown tags.

word.description: Upstream word or phrase, preserved exactly.

title: Datamuse Find Words
